provider: RunPod (api.runpod.io/graphql); not among the compute providers of research/AUTHORITY.json
image_note: by tag, not by digest: the host is not trusted, and what it returns is judged again by the caller's own verifier
seconds_note: seconds: one limit for each paid step, all under one deadline (their sum). end_seconds: the controller tries to delete the host for this long, and this is counted in the planned worst case; a deletion that fails costs more. late_seconds: after a failed request for a host the controller looks again this much later. guard_seconds: the second process keeps trying this long. grace: after the deadline the provider is asked to end the host itself (terminateAfter); in a drill it did not within 3.5 minutes of the time asked, so the run does not rely on it
gpus_note: the two sm_90 types asked for by name; only the first, in the provider's SECURE cloud, has been run
